text:
Anya: Quick sprint snapshot for runtime perf work — posting async so folks can chime in when free. TL;DR: kernel micro-optimizations on track, continuous-batching perf tests flaked yesterday, KV warmup needs owner + tiny infra tweak.

Joel: Thanks Anya. Kernel PRs merged: #4123 and #4130. Microkernel path now uses fused softmax for 8k tokens; perf win ~8% p99 on synthetic load. Still need one more perf run on staging.

Samir: Noted. Continuous-batching tests failed due to flaky sequence-window alignment. I pushed a test fix but need infra to restart the canary cluster (stateful).

Lee: @Samir I can do the restart. ETA 30m. Can you paste the exact canary name?

Samir: Canary name `cbatch-canary-3`. Issue reproduced with this command: `python perf/run_batch_test.py --seq-window 64 --clients 200`. Failing log snippet: 
```
ERROR: Sequence window mismatch: expected 64 got 0
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "run_batch_test.py", line 223, in <module>
    main()
```

Anya: Ownership clarifications: Joel owns kernel PRs and rollout; Samir owns continuous-batching test fixes and validation harness; Lee owns canary restart + infra health checks. I'll own the KV warmup follow-up and coordinating with Platform.

Maya: From product side, we care most about the p99 stability — any chance of a fallback plan if continuous batching rollout regresses in prod?

Joel: Yes — we have an automatic fallback gate in the rollout manifest. If p99 latency > SLA for 5m, the canary auto-rolls back to previous model. Manifest excerpt: 
```
rollout_policy: 
  monitor: latency_p99
  threshold_ms: 120
  window: 300
  action: rollback
```

Samir: On KV warmup: hitting coldstart spikes in Dedicated tests. Hypothesis: prefetch handshake sometimes misses for multi-tenant shard. I'll add more logging and a small jitter to the handshake backoff.

Anya: Can someone pick up the KV prewarm infra change? It's a small flag flip on the node agent: `--allow-prefetch=true` but requires a secure rollout. Lee?

Lee: I can handle the agent flag. Will open a small infra PR and annotate it for SRE review. Ping me if you want a canary after Joel's kernel runs.

deploy-bot: deploy requested: infra/agent-allow-prefetch changed by Lee. Status: queued -> starting -> success. (job id: 2026-33-71) :white_check_mark:

Lee: deploy-bot shows success for agent flip on canary. Samir, can you re-run the continuous-batching test now?

Samir: Re-running now. Command: `python perf/run_batch_test.py --seq-window 64 --clients 200 --retries 3`. Will post results in ~10m.

Joel: One more ask re: code reviews — @Samir can you review kernel PR #4140 (small change to KV eviction hook) today? Blocks Joel's follow-up benchmark.

Samir: Taking a look after this run. If tests pass I'll approve and merge.

Anya: Milestones for next 48h: (1) kernel benchmark on staging (Joel) (2) CB tests green on canary (Samir + Lee) (3) KV warmup monitoring added + alert (Anya) — if we hit any regression we'll pause continuous-batching rollout. Posting a checklist so PMs know status.

Maya: Thanks — this is helpful. I'll update the roadmap board and mark risk = medium for the sprint.

Samir: Tests passed on canary (3/3). No sequence-window mismatch. p99 improved ~6% vs baseline. Will follow up with logs and perf dashboard link. :tada:

Joel: Great. I'll schedule the staging benchmark run for 03:00 UTC and post results here.

Anya: Awesome. If anyone hits blockers ping me or DM. Otherwise we'll close this thread after Joel posts the staging numbers. :thumbsup:
